description: Wyoming CV Pilot Traveler Information Message Sample (Schema Version 6) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by United States Department of Transportation -- Recommended citation: "Wyoming Department of Transportation. (2019, Updated daily). Wyoming CV Pilot Traveler Information Message Sample (Schema Version 6). [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504473". This dataset contains a sample of the broadcast Traveler Information Messages (TIM) being generated by the Wyoming Connected Vehicle (CV) Pilot. This dataset only contains SchemaVersion 6 TIM sample data from December 18, 2018 to present. It is updated hourly and will hold up to 3 million of the most recent TIM records. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 69 columns, among them metadata_request_snmp_rsuid, travelerdataframe_content_exitService_sequence, travelerdataframe_content_speedLimit_sequence, travelerdataframe_content_itis, travelerinformation_timeStamp, travelerinformation_packetID. The portal shows 2022-01-14 as the last data update. Attribution given: United States Department of Transportation -- Recommended citation: "Wyoming Department of Transportation. (2019, Update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution | Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
